Instead, your checking-account position was the clearest concern, and the remaining details left the overall risk above the approval standard. To improve your chances, focus on building a stronger checking-account record, ask the lender for the specific conditions that would make you eligible, and consider reapplying after improving those areas or providing additional security or a guarantor.
